name: exec
arguments:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
s=Path('work/input.md').read_text()
body=s.split('---', 2)[2].strip()
blocks=body.split('\n\n')
for block in blocks:
    if block.startswith('#'):
        heading=block.lstrip('# ')
        print(f'Heading: {heading!r}; words={len(heading.split())}; characters={len(heading)}')
    else:
        print(f'Paragraph: words={len(block.split())}; start={block[:74]!r}')
print('Section paragraph counts:')
for sec in re.split(r'^## ', body, flags=re.M)[1:]:
    title, text = sec.split('\n',1)
    print(f'{title}: {len([b for b in text.strip().split(chr(10)+chr(10)) if b.strip()])}')
PY","max_output_tokens":5000});text(r.output);
